Home.metaDescription: Own your trading data. TraderMemos is a self-hosted trading journal with a dashboard, P&L calendar, trade log, playbook, and reports — free, AGPL-3.0, on your own infrastructure.
Home.heroSubtitle: TraderMemos is a self-hosted trading journal — dashboard, P&L calendar, trade log, playbook, and reports on your own infrastructure. No subscription, no vendor lock-in.
Home.featuresSub: From broker CSV to daily review — every step of the loop lives in one self-hosted app.
Home.whyBody: Cloud journals like TradeZella and TraderSync are polished — but your edge lives in the data. TraderMemos follows the same self-hosting philosophy as Ghost, Umami, and Plane: run it on your infrastructure, own the database, extend without permission.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Equity curve, expectancy, streaks, hold times, and annual goal pacing.

tradeLog.title: Trade log
tradeLog.description: Fills grouped into trades — filter, sort, tag, and drill into execution detail.

calendar.title: P&L calendar
calendar.description: Daily and weekly heatmap with drill-down.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Win rate, profit factor, expectancy, and setup / hourly / session breakdowns.

playbook.title: Playbook
playbook.description: Strategy library linked to the trades that used each setup.

import.title: Import
import.description: CSV broker statements, with column mapping and dedup.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Position-size calculator, risk rules, cash ledger.

ai.title: AI (optional)
ai.description: Screenshot fill extraction + trade coach via OpenAI-compatible APIs — your keys.

api.title: API access
api.description: Personal access tokens (tm_pat_…) for MCP/scripts; OpenAPI docs at /docs.

themes.title: Themes
themes.description: Dark and light, built on shadcn/ui + coss ui tokens.

Home.licenseBody: Self-host it, modify it, and run it for yourself or your firm freely.
